1. The return types from various `getAll*` functions don't match the expected types in `getAllJoinTables`. The functions are returning objects with `records` and `pagination` properties, but they're being used as arrays.

2. There are type errors related to indexing into `xata.db` with a string.

3. A property `more` is being destructured but might not exist.

4. Many instances of `any` types that need to be replaced with more specific types.

5. The function `formatGraphEdge` is not defined.

6. There are issues with spreading connection objects that don't have iterable methods.

Let me plan the fixes:

1. Fix the return type of `JoinTablesData` and modify how we handle the return values from the `getAll*` functions, by accessing their `.records` property.

2. Add proper type annotations for the `table` parameter and the result of indexing into `xata.db`.

3. Fix the destructuring of `more` by checking if the property exists first.

4. Replace `any` types with more specific type definitions.

5. Make sure `formatGraphEdge` is imported or defined.

6. Fix the spread operators by properly accessing the record arrays in the connections objects.

Let's start with these fixes.</details></think>

        "contents": "\n\nasync function transformForReactflow(\n\txataResult: XataResult,\n\tsourceNode: ReactFlowNode,\n\texistingNodes: ReactFlowNode[],\n\toriginalType: string,\n\tlayoutType: \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | \"radial\" | \"grid\" = \"horizontal\",\n): Promise\u003cXataToXYFlowResult\u003e {\n\t// Extract the related records from the Xata query result\n\tconst { answer, records } = xataResult;\n\tconst nodes: ReactFlowNode[] = [];\n\tconst edges: ReactFlowEdge[] = [];\n\n\t// Create a central node as the starting point for our graph\n\tconst centralNodeId = sourceNode.id;\n\n\t// Create nodes for each record with parentId set to the source node\n\tfor (const record of records) {\n\t\tif (!record) continue;\n\n\t\t// Create a node for this record\n\t\tconst nodeId = record.id;\n\t\tnodes.push({\n\t\t\tid: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\tposition: { x: 0, y: 0 }, // Initial position will be set by layout\n\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t...record,\n\t\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tparentId: centralNodeId,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Create an edge connecting to the central node\n\t\tedges.push({\n\t\t\tid: &#96;edge-${centralNodeId}-${nodeId}&#96;,\n\t\t\tsource: centralNodeId,\n\t\t\ttarget: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"smoothstep\",\n\t\t\tanimated: true,\n\t\t});\n\t}\n\n\t// Determine the best layout based on number of nodes and type\n\tconst direction = layoutType;\n\tlet spacing = 50;\n\n\t// For radial layouts with many nodes, increase the radius\n\t// by adjusting parentChildSpacing\n\tlet parentChildSpacing = 100;\n\tif (direction === \"radial\" \u0026\u0026 nodes.length \u003e 5) {\n\t\tparentChildSpacing = 120 + nodes.length * 5; // Scale with node count\n\t}\n\n\t// For grid layouts, adjust spacing based on node count\n\tif (direction === \"grid\") {\n\t\tspacing = 30;\n\t}\n\n\t// Apply our layout algorithm to position the nodes\n\tconst layoutedNodes = organizeNodeLayout(nodes, edges, {\n\t\tdirection,\n\t\tparentChildSpacing,\n\t\tsiblingSpacing: spacing,\n\t\tnodeWidth: 200,\n\t\tnodeHeight: 100,\n\t\tcenterChildren: true,\n\t});\n\n\treturn {\n\t\tnodes: layoutedNodes,\n\t\tedges,\n\t};\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nasync function transformForReactflow(\n\txataResult: XataResult,\n\tsourceNode: ReactFlowNode,\n\texistingNodes: ReactFlowNode[],\n\toriginalType: string,\n\tlayoutType: \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | \"radial\" | \"grid\" = \"horizontal\",\n): Promise\u003cXataToXYFlowResult\u003e {\n\t// Extract the related records from the Xata query result\n\tconst { answer, records } = xataResult;\n\tconst nodes: ReactFlowNode[] = [];\n\tconst edges: ReactFlowEdge[] = [];\n\n\t// Create a central node as the starting point for our graph\n\tconst centralNodeId = sourceNode.id;\n\n\t// Create nodes for each record with parentId set to the source node\n\tfor (const record of records) {\n\t\tif (!record) continue;\n\n\t\t// Create a node for this record\n\t\tconst nodeId = record.id;\n\t\tnodes.push({\n\t\t\tid: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\tposition: { x: 0, y: 0 }, // Initial position will be set by layout\n\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t...record,\n\t\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tparentId: centralNodeId,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Create an edge connecting to the central node\n\t\tedges.push({\n\t\t\tid: &#96;edge-${centralNodeId}-${nodeId}&#96;,\n\t\t\tsource: centralNodeId,\n\t\t\ttarget: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"smoothstep\",\n\t\t\tanimated: true,\n\t\t});\n\t}\n\n\t// Determine the best layout based on number of nodes and type\n\tconst direction = layoutType;\n\tlet spacing = 50;\n\n\t// For radial layouts with many nodes, increase the radius\n\t// by adjusting parentChildSpacing\n\tlet parentChildSpacing = 100;\n\tif (direction === \"radial\" \u0026\u0026 nodes.length \u003e 5) {\n\t\tparentChildSpacing = 120 + nodes.length * 5; // Scale with node count\n\t}\n\n\t// For grid layouts, adjust spacing based on node count\n\tif (direction === \"grid\") {\n\t\tspacing = 30;\n\t}\n\n\t// Apply our layout algorithm to position the nodes\n\tconst layoutedNodes = organizeNodeLayout(nodes, edges, {\n\t\tdirection,\n\t\tparentChildSpacing,\n\t\tsiblingSpacing: spacing,\n\t\tnodeWidth: 200,\n\t\tnodeHeight: 100,\n\t\tcenterChildren: true,\n\t});\n\n\treturn {\n\t\tnodes: layoutedNodes,\n\t\tedges,\n\t};\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n\t\tconst connections = {\n\t\t\ttopicsExpertsConnections: topicsExpertsConnections,\n\t\t\teventsExpertsConnections: eventsExpertsConnections,\n\t\t\teventsTopicsExpertsConnections: eventsTopicsExpertsConnections,\n\t\t\ttopicsTestimoniesConnections: topicsTestimoniesConnections,\n\t\t\torganizationsPersonnelConnections: organizationsMembers,\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst links = [\n\t\t\t...connections.eventsExpertsConnections,\n\t\t\t...connections.topicsExpertsConnections,\n\t\t\t...connections.eventsTopicsExpertsConnections,\n\t\t\t...connections.topicsTestimoniesConnections,\n\t\t\t...connections.organizationsPersonnelConnections,\n\t\t]\n\t\t\t.map(({ id, ...rest }) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\tconst [sourceData, targetData] = Object.entries(rest);\n\n\t\t\t\tconst [sourceType, sourceNode]: any = sourceData;\n\n\t\t\t\tconst [targetType, targetNode]: any = targetData;\n\n\t\t\t\t// Check if source and target nodes exist because occassionally a join record can exist in either table while missing the record referenced by the foreign key\n\t\t\t\tconst sourceNodeExists = sourceNode\n\t\t\t\t\t? nodes.find((node) =\u003e node.id === sourceNode.id)\n\t\t\t\t\t: null;\n\t\t\t\tconst targetNodeExists = targetNode\n\t\t\t\t\t? nodes.find((node) =\u003e node.id === targetNode.id)\n\t\t\t\t\t: null;\n\n\t\t\t\tif (sourceNodeExists \u0026\u0026 targetNodeExists) {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn formatGraphEdge({ id, sourceNode, targetNode });\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t.filter((link) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\treturn link \u0026\u0026 link.source \u0026\u0026 link.target;\n\t\t\t});\n\n\t\tconst payload: NetworkGraphPayload = {\n\t\t\trecords,\n\t\t\tconnections,\n\t\t\tgraphData: {\n\t\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\t\tlinks,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\n\t\treturn payload;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t// Return a minimal valid payload\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\trecords: {\n\t\t\t\ttopics: [],\n\t\t\t\tevents: [],\n\t\t\t\tpersonnel: [],\n\t\t\t\ttestimonies: [],\n\t\t\t\torganizations: [],\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tconnections: {\n\t\t\t\ttopicsExpertsConnections: [],\n\t\t\t\teventsExpertsConnections: [],\n\t\t\t\teventsTopicsExpertsConnections: [],\n\t\t\t\ttopicsTestimoniesConnections: [],\n\t\t\t\torganizationsPersonnelConnections: [],\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tgraphData: {\n\t\t\t\tnodes: [],\n\t\t\t\tlinks: [],\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t} as NetworkGraphPayload;\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get topics related to a specific testimony\n * @param testimonyId The ID of the testimony to get related topics for\n * @returns Array of topic records related to the testimony\n */\nexport async function getTopicsByTestimony(\n\ttestimonyId: string,\n): Promise\u003cTopicsRecord[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tif (!testimonyId) {\n\t\t\tthrow createTopicError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Testimony ID is required\",\n\t\t\t\t\"MISSING_TESTIMONY_ID\",\n\t\t\t\t\"getTopicsByTestimony\",\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Query the relationship table to get the topics\n\t\tconst relationships = await xata.db[\"topics-testimonies\"].query({\n\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\"testimony.id\": testimonyId,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\n\t\tif (relationships.records.length === 0) {\n\t\t\treturn [];\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Extract topic IDs\n\t\tconst topicIds = relationships.records\n\t\t\t.filter((rel) =\u003e rel.topic?.id)\n\t\t\t.map((rel) =\u003e rel.topic?.id as string);\n\n\t\tif (topicIds.length === 0) {\n\t\t\treturn [];\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Get all topics by these IDs\n\t\tconst topics = await getAllTopics({\n\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\tid: {\n\t\t\t\t\t$any: topicIds,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn topics;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error getting topics for testimony ${testimonyId}:&#96;, error);\n\n\t\tthrow createTopicError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to get topics for testimony: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"QUERY_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"getTopicsByTestimony\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Get testimonies related to a specific event\n * @param eventId The ID of the event to filter by\n * @returns Array of testimony records related to the event\n */\nexport async function getTestimoniesByEvent(\n\teventId: string,\n): Promise\u003cTestimoniesRecord[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tif (!eventId) {\n\t\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Event ID is required\",\n\t\t\t\t\"MISSING_EVENT_ID\",\n\t\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesByEvent\",\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn await getAllTestimonies({\n\t\t\tfilter: {\n\t\t\t\t\"event.id\": eventId,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error getting testimonies for event ${eventId}:&#96;, error);\n\n\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to get testimonies for event: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"QUERY_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesByEvent\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Gets all topics with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination\n * @param options Optional configuration for filtering, sorting, and pagination\n * @returns Array of topic records\n */\nexport async function getAllTopics(options?: {\n\tfilter?: RecordFilterExpression\u003cTopicsRecord\u003e;\n\tsort?: Record\u003cstring, \"asc\" | \"desc\"\u003e;\n\tpagination?: { size?: number; offset?: number };\n\tcolumns?: string[];\n\tconsistency?: \"strong\" | \"eventual\";\n}): Promise\u003cTopicsRecord[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Build query options\n\t\tconst queryOptions: {\n\t\t\tfilter?: RecordFilterExpression\u003cTopicsRecord\u003e;\n\t\t\tsort?: [string, \"asc\" | \"desc\"][];\n\t\t\tcolumns?: string[];\n\t\t\tpagination?: { size: number; offset: number };\n\t\t\tconsistency?: \"strong\" | \"eventual\";\n\t\t} = {\n\t\t\tconsistency: options?.consistency || \"strong\",\n\t\t};\n\n\t\t// Add filter if provided\n\t\tif (options?.filter) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.filter = options.filter;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add sort if provided\n\t\tif (options?.sort) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.sort = Object.entries(options.sort).map(\n\t\t\t\t([column, direction]) =\u003e [column, direction],\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add columns if provided\n\t\tif (options?.columns) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.columns = options.columns;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add pagination if provided\n\t\tif (options?.pagination) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.pagination = {\n\t\t\t\tsize: options.pagination.size || 50,\n\t\t\t\toffset: options.pagination.offset || 0,\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Execute query with options\n\t\tconst result = await xata.db.topics.query(queryOptions);\n\t\treturn result.records;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error getting all topics:\", error);\n\n\t\tthrow createTopicError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to get topics: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"QUERY_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"getAllTopics\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Gets all topics with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination\n * @param options Optional configuration for filtering, sorting, and pagination\n * @returns Array of topic records\n */\nexport async function getAllTopics(options?: {\n\tfilter?: RecordFilterExpression\u003cTopicsRecord\u003e;\n\tsort?: Record\u003cstring, \"asc\" | \"desc\"\u003e;\n\tpagination?: { size?: number; offset?: number };\n\tcolumns?: string[];\n\tconsistency?: \"strong\" | \"eventual\";\n}): Promise\u003cTopicsRecord[]\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Build query options\n\t\tconst queryOptions: {\n\t\t\tfilter?: RecordFilterExpression\u003cTopicsRecord\u003e;\n\t\t\tsort?: [string, \"asc\" | \"desc\"][];\n\t\t\tcolumns?: string[];\n\t\t\tpagination?: { size: number; offset: number };\n\t\t\tconsistency?: \"strong\" | \"eventual\";\n\t\t} = {\n\t\t\tconsistency: options?.consistency || \"strong\",\n\t\t};\n\n\t\t// Add filter if provided\n\t\tif (options?.filter) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.filter = options.filter;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add sort if provided\n\t\tif (options?.sort) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.sort = Object.entries(options.sort).map(\n\t\t\t\t([column, direction]) =\u003e [column, direction],\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add columns if provided\n\t\tif (options?.columns) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.columns = options.columns;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add pagination if provided\n\t\tif (options?.pagination) {\n\t\t\tqueryOptions.pagination = {\n\t\t\t\tsize: options.pagination.size || 50,\n\t\t\t\toffset: options.pagination.offset || 0,\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Execute query with options\n\t\tconst result = await xata.db.topics.query(queryOptions);\n\t\treturn result.records;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error getting all topics:\", error);\n\n\t\tthrow createTopicError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to get topics: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"QUERY_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"getAllTopics\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n}",
